tx-bexar-2026-dist-225-vasquez-hortick-c.name: Christine Vasquez Hortick
tx-bexar-2026-dist-225-vasquez-hortick-c.bio: Judge of the 225th Civil District Court since 2022; formerly a sole-practitioner attorney, Texas RioGrande Legal Aid law clerk, and congressional aide.

tx-bexar-2026-dist-226-ochoa-nelson-anas.name: Anastacia "Ana" Ochoa Nelson
tx-bexar-2026-dist-226-ochoa-nelson-anas.bio: Prosecutor with more than a decade of experience in the Bexar County District Attorney's Office.

tx-bexar-2026-dist-227-del-prado-christi.name: Christine Del Prado
tx-bexar-2026-dist-227-del-prado-christi.bio: Judge of the 227th Criminal District Court since 2022; former chief of the Public Integrity and Cyber Crime division of the Bexar County District Attorney's Office.

tx-bexar-2026-dist-285-nieto-nadine.name: Nadine Melissa Nieto
tx-bexar-2026-dist-285-nieto-nadine.bio: Presiding Judge of the 285th District Court since 2022; previously a trial litigator for 27 years.

tx-bexar-2026-dist-288-chapa-cynthia.name: Cynthia Marie Chapa
tx-bexar-2026-dist-288-chapa-cynthia.bio: Judge of the 288th District Court since 2018; previously ran her own law firm.

tx-bexar-2026-dist-289-sosa-rose.name: Rose Sosa
tx-bexar-2026-dist-289-sosa-rose.bio: Attorney with experience as a defense attorney and prosecutor, including 22 years at the Bexar County District Attorney's Office, and as a Bexar County magistrate judge.

tx-bexar-2026-county-judge-von-dohlen-pa.name: Patrick Von Dohlen
tx-bexar-2026-county-judge-von-dohlen-pa.bio: Values-based financial adviser with 28 years of experience.

positions.stance: Supports balancing the county budget and focusing on core services.
Pledges to "foster safety in every district and neighborhood for our families."
Wants daily processes that "ensure accountability, efficiency and transparency" in county government.
Supports fostering economic development "through conscientious growth."
Lists "Celebrate Our History" among the steps to make Bexar County the best place to live, work and raise a family.
Believes "safety starts both in our neighborhoods and in the systems that protect them" and that "real safety means being proactive, not reactive."
Plans to streamline processes, support small businesses, and strengthen the local workforce.
Would coordinate cities, school districts and housing authorities, building on the Strategic Housing Implementation Plan so every family has a fair shot at a stable home.
Would balance roadway maintenance and construction with improved transit, expanded regional connectivity, and better pedestrian and bike mobility.
Will champion sustainable development and engage fully with the Climate Action and Adaptation Plan, balancing growth with conservation.

tx-bexar-2026-ccl1-petry-stowe-helen.name: Helen Petry Stowe
tx-bexar-2026-ccl1-petry-stowe-helen.bio: Judge of Bexar County Court at Law No. 1 since 2018; former felony prosecutor in the Bexar County District Attorney's Office and middle school English teacher.

tx-bexar-2026-ccl2-saenz-melissa.name: Melissa Saenz
tx-bexar-2026-ccl2-saenz-melissa.bio: Judge of Bexar County Court at Law No. 2 since 2023; former prosecutor in the Bexar County District Attorney's Office.

tx-bexar-2026-ccl3-rodriguez-david.name: David J. Rodriguez
tx-bexar-2026-ccl3-rodriguez-david.bio: Judge of Bexar County Court at Law No. 3 since 2003.

tx-bexar-2026-ccl4-ximenez-alfredo.name: Alfredo Ximenez
tx-bexar-2026-ccl4-ximenez-alfredo.bio: Judge with 8 years on the bench and 22 years of experience as a practicing attorney.

tx-bexar-2026-ccl5-arevalos-andrea.name: Andrea Arevalos
tx-bexar-2026-ccl5-arevalos-andrea.bio: Judge of Bexar County Court at Law No. 5.

tx-bexar-2026-ccl6-dominguez-erica.name: Erica Dominguez
tx-bexar-2026-ccl6-dominguez-erica.bio: Judge of Bexar County Court at Law No. 6 and the Misdemeanor Veterans Treatment Court; U.S. Air Force veteran and former Bexar County public defender.

tx-bexar-2026-ccl7-lira-melanie.name: Melanie M. Lira
tx-bexar-2026-ccl7-lira-melanie.bio: Judge of Bexar County Court at Law No. 7; previously an immigration attorney.

tx-bexar-2026-ccl8-brown-celeste.name: Celeste Brown
tx-bexar-2026-ccl8-brown-celeste.bio: Attorney since 1994, former Judge of Bexar County Court at Law No. 8 (2015-2018), alternate Bexar County justice of the peace judge, and business owner.

positions.stance: "Rulings grounded in statute, precedent, and evidence—applied consistently so the process is predictable and trusted by the public and the bar."
"Every party deserves a fair hearing"; patient attention to the record and arguments builds confidence in the judiciary.
"Firm expectations for decorum and preparedness," without losing respect for jurors, witnesses, attorneys, and self-represented litigants.
"Smart docket management that reduces backlog, honors people's time, and delivers timely justice."

tx-bexar-2026-ccl8-cruz-victoria.name: Victoria Cruz
tx-bexar-2026-ccl8-cruz-victoria.bio: Attorney practicing criminal defense, family law and immigration-related defense; formerly with the RAICES children's program.

tx-bexar-2026-ccl9-previti-austin-daphne.bio: Attorney since the 1990s who has served as a criminal and juvenile defense attorney, prosecutor, juvenile law referee, and judge of the 289th District Court.

tx-bexar-2026-ccl9-gonzalez-jessica.name: Jessica A. Gonzalez
tx-bexar-2026-ccl9-gonzalez-jessica.bio: Attorney with more than 8 years as a prosecutor in the Bexar County District Attorney's Office and more than 12 years as a defense attorney.

tx-bexar-2026-ccl12-zamora-lauren.bio: Attorney in the Bexar County District Attorney's Conviction Integrity Unit; formerly an assistant public defender, private defense attorney, and child welfare attorney.

tx-bexar-2026-ccl14-martinez-audrey.bio: Felony prosecutor for Karnes and Atascosa counties and former prosecutor in the Bexar County District Attorney's Office.
